title: Canonical pullback tensor isomorphism for mixed global Hom
statement: Let $h:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and choose sheaf derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists a natural isomorphism from $\otimes_S^L$ followed by $Lh^*$ to $(Lh^*\times Lh^*)$ followed by $\otimes_T^L$, whose forward components satisfy the shared-counit normalization of [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. It imposes no relation on any independently chosen module derived localization universe.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical comparison using exists_canonicalPullbackTensorComparison, which transports the model counit to SingleComplexBaseChange.counit through exists_canonical_from_model. Package its two-variable naturality as a natural transformation. No raw model tensorator is selected.

Prove localization tensor maps invertible on K-flat inputs using derived monoidal localization. Transfer K-flat invertibility of a universal pullback counit to the shared counit by leftDerivedLift and its factorization equation. Tensor and pullback preserve K-flatness, so the canonical coordinate equation implies the comparison is invertible on representatives. Resolve arbitrary objects by K-flat complexes, use naturality to transport invertibility, and form NatIso.ofComponents.

theorem exists_mixedHomTensorPullbackIso {T S : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) :
    ∃ t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory S) ⋙ derivedPullback h ≅
      (derivedPullback h).prod (derivedPullback h) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory T),
      IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison h (fun K L ↦ t.hom.app (K, L))
